## Authentication

### Providing credentials
- Prefer passing auth as request headers or cookies at call time (do not hardcode secrets into the skill).

## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (2)
- `GET /{token}` — Authenticate using a token.
- `POST /3/auth/refresh` — Refresh the authentication token.

### Data Read (5)
- `GET /3/{3Id}` — Retrieve detailed information for a specific Resy ID.
- `GET /3/cities/new-york-ny/list/{listId}` — Get a list of cities.
- `GET /4/venue/calendar` — Retrieve venue calendar availability.
- `GET /wp-json/wp/v2/{v2Id}` — Retrieve content.
- `GET /wp-json/wp/v2/pages/{pageId}` — Retrieve content from a specific page.

### Data Write (4)
- `POST /2/announcements` — Post new announcements.
- `POST /api/consent/management/report/error` — Report an error related to consent management.
- `POST /capture` — Capture data.
- `POST /tags/v1` — Create or update tags.

### Search (1)
- `POST /4/find` — Find available reservations.

### Media (1)
- `GET /3/google/static_maps/url/sign` — Get a signed URL for a static Google Map.

### Realtime (1)
- `GET /3/events/{eventId}` — Get real-time event details.

### Config (3)
- `GET /2/config` — Get Resy configuration settings.
- `GET /3/location/config` — Get location-specific configuration.
- `POST /4/optimizely/feature-flags` — Fetch feature flag configurations.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Resy's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Resy data without official API access
- Automate actions on api.resy.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Resy frontend uses

    // Auth expired — need to re-capture

  }
}
